entities.name: Maeveen O'Donagh
entities.description: A soldier and captain under Vervamon in the Dark Age of Dominaria, member of the hidden Council of Mages and author of Memoirs of a Soldier.

entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: A man Maeveen saved and later developed feelings for.

entities.name: Sacumon
entities.description: A blood witch killed by Maeveen's team in the Niroso caves.

entities.name: Coernn
entities.description: A sorcerer who died fighting Sacumon.

entities.name: Mytaru
entities.description: Yunnie's blood-brother, who sacrificed himself to disable Tiyint.

entities.name: Sigil of Iwset
entities.description: Allegedly the key to the Tomb of the Seven Martyrs; found in Shingol and smashed by Yunnie.

entities.name: Shingol
entities.description: A fishing village where the sigil was found.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: An island where Maeveen said she would continue her adventures.

events.summary: Maeveen's team killed the blood witch Sacumon in the Niroso caves at the cost of Coernn's life.
events.quote: killing Sacumon at the cost of Coernn's life

events.summary: Mytaru sacrificed himself so the colossus Tiyint could be disabled.
events.quote: only with the sacrifice of Yunnie's blood-brother Mytaru could the giant statue be disabled

events.summary: Maeveen and Yunnie found the Sigil of Iwset in Yunnie's childhood home.
events.quote: they found the Sigil of Iwset under the floor in Yunnie's childhood home

events.summary: Yunnie refused to marry Lady Edara and smashed the sigil.
events.quote: he refused this, smashing the sigil and leaving the others to pick up the pieces

relations.quote: She was a captain serving under Vervamon the Elder
Although Maeveen and Yunnie had developed feelings for one another, they did not manage to express this
